name: Maya Elisabeth Lindqvist Hargreaves
extra_bullets: Set up a monthly customer council of eight store managers who review early designs before anything goes to engineering
Wrote the help center articles for saved cards and answered support questions during the first two weeks after launch
Trained two new analysts on the order database and the weekly report process
cover_letter_paragraph: I also care about the unglamorous parts of product work. I keep a decision log for every feature, write release notes the support team can actually use, and check the numbers again a month after launch, not just the week after. It makes the next planning cycle much easier for everyone.
